This certificate is valid for 5 years after date of shipment considering the storage instructions given below. ## Description of the Material The Certified Reference Material BAM-P011 is distributed in packaging sizes of 1 g, 2 g, 5 g and 10 g. The weight of single pellets of the polymer material is approximately 20 mg. ## Intended Use BAM-P011 is primarily intended for calibration and performance evaluation of instruments used to determine the molar mass and the molar mass distribution of polymers. ## Storage This material should be stored at dry and light protected conditions below +7 °C.
